limitations: Exploratory deterministic matches. Evaluator A alternates first player in paired games from the same opening; repeated openings and finite samples do not establish general tournament strength. Per-move node/time budgets are reset for each move; totals below sum actual measurements across each whole game. Time limits are checked between search nodes and are soft, so wall time can exceed the requested limit.
